<thought>Based on the dominant m/z 127.0997 peak (likely [M+H]+), the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈126.092 Da. The isotopic pattern (~8 % M+1) suggests ~8 carbons. A formula that fits this mass and carbon count is C₈H₁₄O (exact monoisotopic mass 126.1045 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula is C8H14O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
